bodyHtml:
What This Is

Inference technique using a small draft model to propose tokens verified in parallel by a larger model, cutting latency and compute per output token by several multiples.. Achieved.

Early commercial products exist. Market is forming with limited but growing deployment. Our research database tracks 1 independent source on this technology.

Speculative decoding among architectural innovations cutting compute requirements by several multiples without quality loss. MoE, quantization, speculative decoding each contributing. Allianz Research 2026.
